qualifier: protein-level assembly, turnover and EMT at adherens junctions
name: Cadherin adhesion, turnover and EMT at adherens junctions
rationale: All members concern E-cadherin/cadherin-11 adhesion at adherens junctions, its protein trafficking, degradation, pathogen exploitation and loss in EMT; unlike C1 it acts at the protein/junction level rather than cadherin gene transcription, and it is more cadherin-specific than the broad apical-junction confusables.

qualifier: with enteric and autonomic neural crest
name: Hindbrain, cranial nerve and enteric nervous system development
rationale: Members cover hindbrain/brainstem maturation, branchiomotor and trigeminal/facial nerve development and brainstem-controlled behaviours (suckling, respiration), plus enteric/autonomic neural crest and peristalsis, which the spinal-cord-patterning confusables lack.

qualifier: phenotypic switching and vessel remodeling
name: Vascular smooth muscle cell phenotypic switching and remodeling
rationale: All members regulate vascular smooth muscle cell proliferation, migration, apoptosis, differentiation/dedifferentiation and phenotypic switching in vessel remodeling, distinct from endothelial (C1-C3) and cardiac muscle (C4) confusables.

qualifier: Golgi adaptor-coated vesicle sorting
name: Lysosome-related organelle biogenesis by Golgi coated-vesicle sorting
rationale: Members share adaptor/clathrin-coated vesicle cargo sorting from the Golgi that builds lysosomes, melanosomes, platelet dense granules and synaptic vesicles; confusables instead cover melanin pigmentation, endocytic clathrin coats or general secretion.

qualifier: heart tube, chamber myocardium and conduction system
name: Heart tube, chamber myocardium and conduction system development
rationale: Members span heart tube patterning, secondary heart field, ventricular/atrial myocardium and trabeculation, cardiomyocyte fate and nodal/His-Purkinje conduction development, whereas confusables centre on septa, valves/cushions or outflow tract and coronary vessels.

qualifier: sex steroid and thyroid hormone receptors
name: Nuclear sex steroid and thyroid hormone receptor transcription
rationale: Members are estrogen, androgen, progesterone and thyroid hormone receptor signaling and their transcriptional output, which distinguishes them from the RUNX2/bone, liver, retinoic acid and reproductive-cycle confusables.

qualifier: retinal-clearing defects and A2E formation
name: Visual cycle retinal recycling, its defects and A2E formation
rationale: All members concern regeneration of 11-cis-retinal in rods and cones, its RDH5/RDH12/ABCA4 defects and the toxic A2E byproduct under high light, unlike confusables on vitamin A uptake/storage or the opsin phototransduction cascade.

qualifier: de novo
name: De novo purine nucleotide biosynthesis
rationale: All members describe de novo synthesis of IMP and AMP, distinct from purine salvage, pyrimidine synthesis and folate one-carbon confusables.

qualifier: monoaminergic, sympathetic and sensory neurons
name: Axon guidance of monoaminergic, sympathetic and sensory neurons
rationale: Members share axon guidance and projection extension, specified for dopaminergic, serotonergic, sympathetic and dorsal root ganglion neurons, whereas confusables are defined by netrin/semaphorin cue signaling or cranial nerves.

qualifier: non-vesicular transport of glycolipids and phospholipids
name: Non-vesicular intermembrane transfer of glycolipids and phospholipids
rationale: Members share protein-mediated lipid transfer between membranes (glycosphingolipids, ceramide-1-phosphate, PI/PC), unlike confusables on flippases, vesicular traffic, ER tethering or phospholipid synthesis.

qualifier: nucleobase salvage to IMP
name: Purine nucleobase salvage to IMP
rationale: All members describe HPRT-dependent salvage of hypoxanthine/guanine bases to IMP, distinct from purine catabolism, deoxynucleoside defects and ribonucleoside salvage confusables.

qualifier: feeder amino acids and inherited enzyme/transporter defects
name: Urea cycle nitrogen disposal, feeder amino acids and inherited defects
rationale: Members cover the urea cycle, ammonium handling, arginine/ornithine/citrulline and glutamate/aspartate supply, and inherited urea-cycle enzyme and transporter disorders, which proline, glycine and conjugation confusables lack.

core: Meiotic division progression and chromosome segregation
qualifier: oocyte spindle, cohesion and checkpoint control
name: Meiotic division progression and segregation, oocyte spindle-centred
rationale: Members regulate meiotic cell-cycle transitions, cohesion, spindle positioning and chromosome segregation, mostly in female meiosis, whereas confusables centre on meiotic recombination, synapsis and male meiosis.

qualifier: lipoxins, leukotriene B4 turnover and platelet-activating factor
name: Lipoxin and leukotriene B4 metabolism with platelet-activating factor
rationale: Members concern lipoxygenase-derived HETEs and lipoxins, leukotriene B4 omega-oxidation/catabolism and ether-lipid PAF metabolism, unlike confusables on cysteinyl leukotrienes, receptors or P450 epoxygenase products.

qualifier: acetylcholine and glutamate release
name: Vesicle docking and priming for acetylcholine and glutamate release
rationale: Members share SNARE-assembly-dependent vesicle docking and priming and the acetylcholine/glutamate release cycles, whereas confusables cover calcium-triggered fusion, Rab signaling or monoamine release cycles.

qualifier: adipogenesis and mitochondrial biogenesis
name: Nuclear receptor control of adipogenesis and mitochondrial biogenesis
rationale: Members are PPAR, ROR/REV-ERB, PGC-1alpha and steroid-responsive transcription driving white adipocyte differentiation and mitochondrial biogenesis, distinct from circadian-only, gluconeogenic and LXR lipid confusables.

qualifier: p53 and CDC25A ubiquitin-mediated turnover
name: DNA damage G2 checkpoint through p53 and CDC25A turnover
rationale: Members share the radiation-induced G2 checkpoint enforced by p53 phosphorylation/degradation control (incl. COP1) and CDC25A degradation, unlike confusables on G2/M recovery or p53-driven repair transcription.

qualifier: complement, defensins and neutrophil granule cargo
name: Complement, defensins and neutrophil granule antimicrobial defense
rationale: Members cover complement activation/regulation, antimicrobial peptides, metal sequestration and neutrophil granule killing of microbes, whereas confusables centre on neutrophil recruitment, respiratory burst and Fc receptor signaling.

qualifier: control of gluconeogenesis and triglyceride use
name: Glucose and glucagon signaling controlling gluconeogenesis and triglyceride use
rationale: Members share glucose-responsive (ChREBP) and glucagon/PKA signaling that set gluconeogenesis and triglyceride turnover, unlike adipogenesis, insulin/glucose-uptake, glycogen and LXR lipogenesis confusables.

qualifier: aggresome formation and aggrephagy
name: Aggresome formation and aggrephagy
rationale: All members concern assembling misfolded-protein aggresomes and their selective autophagic removal, unlike stress granule, microautophagy, ERAD or refolding confusables.

Only a subset (Fanconi anemia pathway, interstrand cross-link repair, protein monoubiquitination/deubiquitination) is coherent; the rest are unrelated gene-module descriptions (RB1/BCL2L1, mitochondrial housekeeping, Polycomb chromatin, centrosomal proteins), ribosome assembly and inner cell mass proliferation with no shared biological theme.

qualifier: iron, heme, copper and manganese transport
name: Iron, heme, copper and manganese transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members cover uptake, transport, detoxification and inherited disorders of iron (transferrin, ferroportin, ceruloplasmin), heme, copper, manganese and cobalt, unlike cadmium/metallothionein, oxygen transport and scavenger receptor confusables.

qualifier: COPII export and COPI retrograde budding
name: COPII export and COPI retrograde ER-Golgi vesicle budding
rationale: Members share coat-mediated budding between ER and Golgi, COPII cargo export and COPI retrograde/anterograde traffic, whereas confusables cover intra-Golgi traffic, Golgi organization, COPI-independent retrograde transport or tethering.

qualifier: male sex determination and testis
name: Male sex determination, testis and germ cell development
rationale: Members cover male sex determination, testis differentiation, Sertoli/Leydig cells, AMH signaling and germ cell migration and proliferation, unlike ovarian, female cycle and genital tract confusables.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor signaling and degranulation
name: Neutrophil formyl peptide receptor signaling and degranulation
rationale: Members share neutrophil activation via formyl peptide and complement receptors, recruitment and degranulation, whereas confusables emphasize chemotaxis/extravasation or monocyte and TLR inflammatory programs.
